title: The sticker vote closed with 2 of 6 ballots: extend it to 18:00?
headline: The vote closed at 14:30 with two ballots, Silvio's and Angelo's, both verified and counted: The keys leads (19 points), then the road-trip patch and Least privilege (16 each), the tram ticket (15). You, Jose, Indi and Vicky did not vote, so the flow has been tested by two people only. The 12:00 was held without you (Angelo, Jose, Silvio, Vicky): one decision, in Angelo's words, "present team members are ok with generic business cards", and nine follow-ups with owners. Silvio's conductor put three questions only you can answer on the 18:00. Vicky's display name is now "Vicky Wang" on the roster and my pages.
